name: Villanueva de Gumiel (Spain)
description: White field with a central panel divided vertically green and purple bearing the crowned municipal arms of Villanueva de Gumiel (a castle on red and a tree with a flower on green), and in the corners a yellow castle and a red lion alternating.
history: Municipal flag of Villanueva de Gumiel; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: central panel divided green and purple
Villanueva de Gumiel arms — castle and tree with a flower
castles in the upper hoist and lower fly corners
lions in the upper fly and lower hoist corners
